items.summary: Jose Alvarado is set to miss the New York Knicks' NBA Cup matchup against the Philadelphia 76ers on Friday due to a right ankle injury. The Knicks are 2-3 on the season heading into Friday.

items.summary: The New York Knicks will decline Pacome Dadiet's fourth-year option worth $5.37 million, sources told Shams Charania of ESPN.
